_comment: The single source for Anthropic model ids. Before this file there were three
lists that disagreed: ClaudeLink/ClaudeCLI.swift (picker + retired map),
(DEFAULT_MODEL). Node reads this file; the Mac keeps no literal list (the
live list comes from the backend) and scripts/conformance-agent-v2.mjs
asserts it does not grow one back.
`models` is the PICKER fallback (what a user may choose when the live list is
unavailable). `chain` is the server's metering fallback order. They are
different concerns, but every `chain` id is a live model: `default` is always
a `chain` entry, and `chain` never names a key of `retired`.
`retired` maps every id that is no longer listed (the pre-5.5 ids that used to
sit in default/chain/models) to its 5.5-family successor. Successors are never
themselves retired keys, so no mapping chains. The OPEN DECISION about chain
entries being retired keys is resolved: the chain now uses the live ids.
